composition_variation: Create a charming high-quality anime illustration of Panda from Jujutsu Kaisen enjoying a peaceful bamboo-grove picnic. Preserve his recognizable large black-and-white panda character silhouette, friendly dark eye patches, rounded ears, and relaxed expression. He sits upright on a small woven mat with paws resting naturally beside a plain wicker lunch basket. Focus on one character only. Use soft cel shading with gouache textures, fresh bamboo green, warm beige ground, dappled sunlight, and light mist opening into an airy upper canopy. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
